source.title: Answer every DM with AI, team as backup

document.title: Answer every DM with AI, team as backup

use_when: Answer varied inbound support questions from a maintained knowledge base, with a named human backup.
avoid_when: Do not use when the business requires a deterministic answer or no human can handle unresolved questions.
Do not silently drop an essential unsupported gate.
required_facts: Knowledge base, answer boundaries, escalation owner and notification destination.
Confirm account scope, messaging permission and the real outcome measurement.
